cases.name: no forms: everyone reads and takes out everything
a live form shows its fields; a marked one stays on screen and does not leave
an unmarked live form: a Veri girişi reads its fields only, the others are whole
a scope by e-mail reaches the caller's records; a layer no form binds is free
two live forms: either one's scope reaches
a live form without a scope reaches every record even beside a scoped one
a scope that names no field of the layer reaches nothing
every form withdrawn: the layer is closed to a Veri girişi, whatever its scope was
a withdrawn form beside a live one: the live one binds
a form never published binds nothing but its marks count
a mark in the draft only counts too
an item names a layer field by its stable id; the attribute is stored under the name
a later release replaces the earlier one's shown fields and marks
two layers with their own forms and marks
a record whose scope field is empty is not reached
